sample_unit: questions (ChatGPT responses), each rated by 7 otolaryngologists (231 evaluations)

links.outcome: Reading level of ChatGPT responses versus AMA-recommended sixth-grade level
links.effect: Mean FRE 57.15 (±10.73), FKGL 9.95 (±1.91); only 3 (9.1%) responses at or below sixth-grade level; over three-quarters at or above 10th-grade level.
links.quote: Upon analyzing the responses from ChatGPT, 3 (9.1 %) were at or below the sixth-grade reading level recommended by the American Medical Association (AMA).

screen.reason: The study evaluates the accuracy and readability (FRE/FKGL) of ChatGPT in answering FAQs for parents about pediatric ENT surgeries, but does not test a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
